skill.summary: Track flights in real-time with detailed status, gate info, delays, and live position. Use when user asks to track a flight, check flight status, look up flight information by flight number (e.g., "track AA100", "what's the status of United 2402", "check my flight BA123"), or wants to display flight data in a formatted view similar to Flighty app.

latestVersion.changelog: Real-time flight tracking with AviationStack API. Displays Flighty-style formatted output with departure/arrival times, gates, delays, and live position.
